f.statement: The PSUR should summarise other accessible clinical trial sources, patterns of medication errors (even without harm), major non-clinical findings (studies on specific safety concerns regardless of outcome), and significant literature findings, with literature searches wider than for ICSRs (pregnancy outcomes, paediatric use, compassionate use, lack of efficacy, asymptomatic overdose, errors without harm, non-clinical results) and Vancouver-style references.
